WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN away_team_id
      ELSE home_team_id
    END AS opponent_team_id,

    CASE WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN home_score ELSE away_score END AS goals_for,
    CASE WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN away_score ELSE home_score END AS goals_against,

    CASE
      WHEN (CASE WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN home_score ELSE away_score END) >
           (CASE WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN away_score ELSE home_score END) THEN 'win'
      WHEN (CASE WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN home_score ELSE away_score END) =
           (CASE WHEN home_team_id = 1 THEN away_score ELSE home_score END) THEN 'draw'
      ELSE 'loss'
    END AS result
  FROM public.game
  WHERE (home_team_id = 1 OR away_team_id = 1)
    AND game_status = 'completed'
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    opponent_team_id,
    COUNT(*) AS games,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS draws,
    SUM(goals_for) AS goals_for,
    SUM(goals_against) AS goals_against,

    ROUND(
      CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)
      END
    , 3) AS win_pct,

    ROUND(
      CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
           ELSE (
             2 * SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             + 1 * SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'draw' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           )::numeric
           / (2 * COUNT(*))
      END
    , 3) AS points_pct
  FROM base
  GROUP BY opponent_team_id
)
SELECT
  agg.opponent_team_id,
  t.team_name AS opponent_name,
  agg.games,
  agg.wins,
  agg.losses,
  agg.draws,
  agg.goals_for,
  agg.goals_against,
  agg.win_pct,
  agg.points_pct
FROM agg
LEFT JOIN public.teams t ON t.team_id = agg.opponent_team_id
ORDER BY agg.games DESC, agg.win_pct ASC;
